```c
#include <sync/zone.h>
```

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="in_zone"></a>`IN_ZONE(zptr)` |  | [Zone](#zone) enter and exit wrapper. |

## Structures

### `Zone` { #zone }

Struct describing a zone.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `owner` | [`Tid`](../types.md#tid) | Current owner. -1 means no owner. |
| `locked` | `_Atomic int` | Atomic integer showing the zone is entered. |
| `event` | [`Handle`](../types.md#handle) | On contention, the event to use. |

## Functions

### `ZoneInit` { #zoneinit }

```c
Err ZoneInit(Zone *z);
```

Create a [Zone](#zone).

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `z` | in | Pointer to a zone object to initialize. |

**Returns:** ZUZU_OK on success, negative error code if the Event object couldn't be created.

### `ZoneDestroy` { #zonedestroy }

```c
Err ZoneDestroy(Zone *z);
```

Destroy a [Zone](#zone).

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `z` | in | Pointer to a zone object to destroy. |

**Returns:** ZUZU_OK on success, negative error code if the Event object couldn't be destroyed.

### `ZoneEnter` { #zoneenter }

```c
Err ZoneEnter(Zone *z);
```

Try entering a [Zone](#zone) and block if it is occupied.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `z` | in | The zone to enter to. |

**Returns:** ZUZU_OK on success.

### `ZoneExit` { #zoneexit }

```c
void ZoneExit(Zone *z);
```

Exit a [Zone](#zone).

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `z` | in | The zone to exit from. |

### `ZoneTryEnter` { #zonetryenter }

```c
Err ZoneTryEnter(Zone *z);
```

Try entering a [Zone](#zone) and return with an error if occupied.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `z` | in | The zone to enter to. |

**Returns:** ZUZU_OK on success, ERR_BUSY if the zone is occupied.
